datum: Alleluia, * alleluia.
Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
The Three Children, * by the command of the king, were cast into the furnace, fearing not the flame of the fire, but saying: Blessed be God!
Christ is risen * from the grave, even He That delivered the Three Children from the burning fiery furnace, Alleluia.
Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia.
Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia.
Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, + and honour, and power, and might be unto our God * for ever and ever. Amen.
V. The Lord reigneth, He is clothed with majesty.
R. The Lord is clothed with strength, and hath girded Himself with power.
V. The voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare ye the way of the Lord.
R. Make His paths straight.
V. Lord, Thou hast been our refuge.
R. In all generations.
V. God hath given His Angels charge over thee.
R. To keep thee in all thy ways.
V. Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God.
R. And defend me from them that rise up against me.
V. In Thy rising O Christ, Alleluia.
R. Let the heavens and the earth be glad, Alleluia.

antiphona-i: Have mercy * upon me, O God.
antiphona-iii: O God, Thou art my God, * early will I seek Thee.
antiphona-iv: Thine anger is turned away, * and Thou comfortest me.
antiphona-v: Praise ye * the Lord from the heavens.

datum: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: + let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light: * let us walk honestly as in the day.
V. Thou hast satisfied us early with Thy mercy.
R. We rejoice and are glad.

Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob: + and He will teach us of His ways, and we will walk in His paths, * for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
Cry aloud, spare not; lift up thy voice like a trumpet, + and show My people their transgressions, * and the house of Jacob their sins.
Come, let us put wood into his bread, + and let us cut him off from the land of the living, * that his name may be no more remembered.
Christ, being raised from the dead, dieth no more, death hath no more dominion over Him. + For in that He died, He died unto sin once: * but in that He liveth, He liveth unto God.
Blessed * be the Lord God of Israël.
Kyrie eleison. Christe eleison. Kyrie eleison.
V. I said: Lord, be merciful unto me.
R. Heal my soul, for I have sinned against Thee.
V. Return, O Lord, how long?
R. And let it repent Thee concerning Thy servants.
V. Let Thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us.
R. According as we hope in Thee.
V. Let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness.
R. And let Thy saints shout for joy.
V. O Lord, save the King.
R. And hear us in the day when we call upon Thee.
V. O Lord, save Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance.
R. And govern them, and lift them up for ever.
V. Remember Thy congregation.
R. Which Thou hast purchased of old.
V. Peace be within thy walls.
R. And prosperity within thy palaces.
V. Let us pray for the faithful departed.
R. O Lord, grant them eternal rest, and let the everlasting light shine upon them!
V. May they rest in peace.
R. Amen.
V. Let us pray for our absent brethren.
R. O Thou my God, save Thy servants that trust in Thee.
V. Let us pray for the sorrowful and the captives.
R. Redeem them, O God of Israël, out of all their troubles.
V. O Lord, send them help from the sanctuary.
R. And strengthen them out of Zion.
V. Hear my prayer, O Lord.
R. And let my cry come unto Thee.
V. Turn us again, O Lord God of Hosts.
R. And cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
V. Arise, O Christ, and help us.
R. And deliver us for Thy Name's sake.

antiphona-i: O Lord, * blot out my transgressions.
antiphona-ii: The health * of my countenance, and my God.
antiphona-iii: Early * will I seek Thee, O God.
antiphona-iv: Save us * all the days of our life, O Lord.
antiphona-v: All ye His Angels, * praise the Lord from the heavens.

datum: The Lord hath raised up * an horn of salvation for us, in the house of His servant David.

antiphona-i: Wash me * thoroughly from mine iniquity, O Lord.
antiphona-ii: Praise becometh Thee, * O God, in Zion.
antiphona-iii: O my God, * my lips shall praise Thee while I live.
antiphona-iv: The Lord shall judge * the ends of the earth.
antiphona-v: Praise God, * ye heavens of heavens.

datum: O Lord, save us * from the hand of all that hate us.

antiphona-i: Against Thee, Thee only, * have I sinned, have mercy upon me, O Lord!
antiphona-ii: Lord, * Thou hast been our refuge.
antiphona-iii: I meditate * upon Thee in the night watches.
antiphona-iv: Let us sing * gloriously unto the Lord.

datum: Let us serve the Lord * in holiness, and He will deliver us from our enemies.

antiphona-i: Uphold mine heart * with Thy free spirit, O God.
antiphona-ii: In thy faithfulness, * answer me, O Lord.
antiphona-iii: O Lord, * cause Thy face to shine upon us.
antiphona-iv: O Lord I have heard * Thy speech, and was afraid.
antiphona-v: Praise God * with the timbrel and dance.

datum: Through the tender mercy of our God * the day-spring from on high hath visited us.

antiphona-i: Do good, * O Lord, in Thy good pleasure.
antiphona-ii: It is a good thing * to give thanks unto the Lord.
antiphona-iii: Let all the ends * of the earth fear the Lord.
antiphona-iv: Ascribe ye greatness * unto our God.
antiphona-v: Praise God * upon the loud cymbals.

datum: Give light, O Lord, * unto them that sit in darkness, and guide our feet into the way of peace, O Thou God of Israël!
